title: Living seasonally in October - a simple day
en: do hello everyone and welcome to my cottage it has been an extremely eventful autumn as you well know after getting engaged there is suddenly a lot to anticipate and consider for the future no doubt i will be experiencing some great changes in my life in the coming year and so it has made it clear to me that i really need to appreciate my time in this sweet cozy little home recently i decided to experiment with

growing my own mushrooms i love wild mushrooms especially morels and they have a very distinct taste that i crave all year i was told oyster mushrooms are also delicious and so i decided to pick up some local grow bags i have always found mushrooms fascinating not only do they look interesting but the way they grow seems so different from many plants i imagine if they could talk they would be quite gentle and unassuming creatures it takes very little space and water to grow them every part of the process is compostable and they don't need any light they're possibly one of the most energy efficient things you can grow they ask so little of the earth and yet they give so much and are known to have

amazing health benefits my father was a navy doctor and we lived in italy for a while and while i was there i developed a deep appreciation for simple high quality whole foods and connecting to the source of what we eat each season while in a modern setting depending on where you live that is understandably hard to do especially because high quality ingredients can be expensive and hard to come by even out here i'd love to find little ways to connect with the food i consume and understand how it grows even if it's something as simple as growing sprouts on my windowsill it's so easy and always delicious one of my favorite things about learning to use a camera is taking time lapses

something about seeing the way that things grow always reminds me of the magic in this world and the way a spore or seed can sprout an entire life form is incredible i once read a book on meditations written by a very wise mystic in it he described how in the midst of winter he would walk through a dormant apple orchard the trees would have no leaves and look completely dead and yet when he touched the bark and put his face up close he could smell the apples

the essence of the fruit was deep inside in the core and roots of the tree even in the dead of winter there was life that tree held within a thousand apples they just hadn't been formed yet i like to apply that idea to our own spirits how we have within us so much potential for giving in my case i like to imagine a seed of light inside my heart during this time of year when the days are quickly getting darker almost like holding a single star that reflects the night sky i need to take care of that star and not let anything suppress its light it is a thought that i use to inspire my meditations perhaps it is something that will inspire you as you reach the end of the year and begin to think about the possibilities of the next
perhaps we don't need to set any particular goal for the future only to dedicate ourselves to tending the light we hold within and do whatever we need in order to let it shine the greater do do

as you can see i've been spending a lot of time on my porch stargazing and i've become infatuated with the night sky as of late i swear moon bunnies are dancing around in my head as i speak thank you for indulging my nighttime
musings i hope you have a lovely day or night take care you
zh: 大家好，欢迎来到我的小屋，这是一个非常多事的秋天，正如你们所知，订婚后突然有很多事情需要预测和考虑未来，毫无疑问，来年我的生活将经历一些巨大的变化，所以这让我很清楚，我真的需要珍惜在这个甜蜜舒适的小家里的时光，最近我决定尝试一下

自己种植蘑菇我喜欢野生蘑菇，尤其是羊肚菌，它们有一种非常独特的味道，我一年四季都渴望，有人告诉我平菇也很美味，所以我决定买一些当地的种植袋，我一直觉得蘑菇很迷人，不仅它们看起来很有趣，而且它们的生长方式似乎与许多植物很不同，我想如果它们会说话，它们会是非常温和和谦虚的生物，种植它们只需要很少的空间和水，整个过程的每个部分都是可堆肥的，它们不需要任何光线它们可能是您可以种植的最节能的植物之一，它们对地球的要求很少，但它们却付出了很多，并且众所周知

惊人的健康益处 我的父亲是一名海军医生，我们在意大利住了一段时间，在那里的时候，我对简单的高质量全食产生了深深的欣赏，并与我们每个季节所吃的食物的来源建立了联系，而在现代环境中，这取决于你居住的地方，这是可以理解的困难，特别是因为高质量的原料可能很昂贵，而且即使在这里也很难获得，我很想找到一些方法来与我消耗的食物建立联系并了解它是如何生长的，即使它像在窗台上种植豆芽一样简单它是如此简单而且总是美味学习使用相机时我最喜欢的事情之一就是拍摄延时摄影
看到事物生长的方式总是让我想起这个世界的魔力，一个孢子或种子萌芽出整个生命形式的方式是令人难以置信的，我曾经读过一本由一位非常聪明的神秘主义者写的关于冥想的书，书中他描述了他如何在冬天穿过一个休眠的苹果园，树木没有叶子，看起来完全死了，但当他触摸树皮并将脸凑近时，他可以闻到苹果的味道

果实的本质深深地存在于树的核心和根部，即使在隆冬，树上的一千个苹果中也蕴藏着生命，它们只是还没有形成，我喜欢将这个想法应用到我们自己的精神上，我们如何在我们的内心有如此多的潜力，在我的例子中，我喜欢想象在一年中的这个时候，当白天很快变黑的时候，我心中有一粒光的种子，几乎就像拿着一颗反映夜空的星星，我需要照顾那颗星星，不要让任何东西压制它的光。我用来启发我冥想的一个想法，也许当你到了年底并开始思考明年的可能性时，它会激励你
也许我们不需要为未来设定任何特定的目标，只需致力于照管我们内心的光芒，做我们需要做的一切，让它闪耀得更伟大。
正如你所看到的，我花了很多时间在门廊上观星，并且最近我迷上了夜空，我发誓当我说话时，月亮兔子在我的脑海里跳舞，谢谢你纵容我的夜晚
沉思 我希望你度过愉快的一天或夜晚 照顾你
